comparisons.reason: Feature 0 requires the quoted OP text to be a specific factual claim (value judgments/opinions quoted give no credit) and the comment must refute that claim. Feature 1 accepts any quoted word, phrase or sentence from the OP's title or argument that the comment argues against, whether factual or opinion. Feature 0 is a materially narrower subtype. Null handling also differs: an empty comment list gives null in 0, while 1 specifies only missing, empty or unparseable OC_comments or OP text. Retain both as written.
